_comment: Databricks Jobs API definition for the config-driven ingestion pipeline.
Import via: databricks jobs create --json @jobs/ingestion_job.json
Or via the Databricks UI: Workflows → Create Job → Import JSON.
BEFORE IMPORTING — update the following placeholders:
REPLACE_WITH_REPO_PATH : e.g. /Repos/data-eng/databricks-ingestion-framework
REPLACE_WITH_NODE_TYPE : e.g. i3.xlarge (AWS) or Standard_DS3_v2 (Azure)
How it works:
main/main.py is a SINGLE task. It accepts a source system filter
(source_system_id OR source_name OR source_type) and internally discovers
all ingestion_object_ids under that source, then runs them in parallel.
pipeline_name is auto-detected from this Job's name and used to further
filter ingestion_config.pipeline_name.
One Databricks Job = one source system.
To run multiple source systems, create one Job per source (each with a
different source_system_id or source_name) and schedule them independently.
Table name overrides (leave blank to use framework defaults from config_manager.py):
source_system_table    : migration_x_catalog.pfl_x_schema.config_source_system
ingestion_config_table : migration_x_catalog.pfl_x_schema.ingestion_config
s3_config_table        : migration_x_catalog.pfl_x_schema.s3_config_master
audit_table            : main.monitoring.data_pipeline_execution_master
S3 ingestion: set source_type = S3 to switch main.py to S3ConfigManager,
which reads s3_config_master (a single denormalized table, one row per
report/object) instead of source_system_table/ingestion_config_table.
Combine with source_system_id/source_name to scope to one S3 source.
delta_layer is read from ingestion_config.delta_layer per object — not a job parameter.
landing_volume_path is a job parameter — set it to your S3/Volume base path.
name: generic_source_to_bronze_ingestion

parameters.name: source_system_id
parameters.description: Source system PK (integer). Set this OR source_name — not both.

parameters.name: source_name
parameters.description: Source system name (e.g. PG_TEST_RDS). Set this OR source_system_id — not both.

parameters.name: source_type
parameters.description: Additional filter by source type (e.g. POSTGRES). Leave blank for all types.

parameters.name: landing_volume_path
parameters.description: Base S3/Volume path for raw landing (e.g. s3://pfl-raw/landing). Leave blank to skip.

parameters.name: max_parallel
parameters.description: Number of tables to ingest concurrently within this job run.

_comment: Single task: discovers all ingestion objects for the given source system
and runs them in parallel using a ThreadPoolExecutor.
pipeline_name is auto-detected from this Job's name.
